units.source_text: 他是源氏的异母弟，人称八皇子。

en.t: He was Genji's half-brother, known as the Eighth Prince.

units.source_text: 冷泉院还当太子的时候，

en.t: When Emperor Reizei was still crown prince,

units.source_text: 朱雀院的母后弘徽殿太后阴谋废冷泉而立这八皇子为太子，

en.t: Suzaku's mother, the Kokiden Empress Dowager, plotted to depose Reizei and make this Eighth Prince crown prince,

units.source_text: 想利用自己的威势捧八皇子上台。

en.t: intending to use her own influence to bring the Eighth Prince to power.

units.source_text: 经过一番扰攘之后，终于失败，受到源氏一派冷遇。

en.t: After a period of turmoil, the scheme ultimately failed, and he was coldly treated by Genji's faction.

units.source_text: 到了源氏一派逐渐得势之时，这八皇子就无法出人头地了。

en.t: By the time Genji's faction gradually gained power, this Eighth Prince had no chance to rise in the world.

units.source_text: 近几年来，他已变成一个高僧，

en.t: In recent years, he had become a revered monk,

units.source_text: 如今则一切世事都抛舍了。

en.t: and now he had cast aside all worldly affairs.

units.source_text: 在这期间，八皇子的宫邸忽遭回禄。

en.t: During this time, the Eighth Prince's residence was suddenly destroyed by fire.

units.source_text: 失势而又遭灾，心情更加苦闷颓唐。

en.t: Having lost power and then suffered disaster, he grew even more anguished and dispirited.

units.source_text: 京中没有适当住宅可以移居。

en.t: There was no suitable residence in the capital to which he could move.

units.source_text: 幸而在宇治地方，尚有一所美好的山庄，

en.t: Fortunately, in the Uji area there was still a fine mountain villa,

units.source_text: 便率眷迁住其中。

en.t: so he moved there with his family.

units.source_text: 世事虽然都已抛舍，但想起了今后神京永隔，亦不免伤心叹息。

en.t: Though he had cast aside worldly affairs, he could not help grieving and sighing when he thought that from then on he would be forever separated from the sacred capital.

units.source_text: 这宇治山庄位在水声聒耳的宇治川岸上，与鱼梁相接近。

en.t: This Uji villa stood on the noisy bank of the Uji River, close to the fish weir.

units.source_text: 在此静修佛道，未免不甚相宜，然亦无可奈何。

en.t: It was not very suitable for quiet Buddhist practice, but there was nothing to be done.

units.source_text: 春花秋叶、青山碧水虽然聊可慰情，

en.t: Although the spring flowers and autumn leaves, the green mountains and clear waters, offered some comfort,

units.source_text: 但八亲王来此之后越发消沉，除了愁叹之外别无他事。

en.t: after coming here the Eighth Prince became still more dejected, doing nothing but lamenting.

units.source_text: 他无时不思念亡妻，常说：

en.t: He constantly thought of his late wife and often said:

units.source_text: “笼闭在这隔断红尘的深山中，安得故人相依为命！”

en.t: "Shut away in these deep mountains cut off from the dusty world, if only my old companion were here to share this life with me!"

units.source_text: 曾赋诗云：

en.t: He once composed a poem, saying:
